result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with a marked zebra crosswalk and overhead traffic signals. However, the lack of a pedestrian refuge island and the significant crossing distance across four or more lanes of traffic increase pedestrian exposure and risk.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a mid-block refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear in the asphalt surface near the crossing area.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground of the image in the roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians and break up the crossing into two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the total crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reconfigure the roadway to reduce the number of through lanes, which can lower vehicle speeds and provide space for a median or bike lanes.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane intersection in a commercial area with significant crossing distances for pedestrians. While basic infrastructure like a marked crosswalk and traffic signals are present, the environment is heavily car-centric with incomplete sidewalk connectivity and high-speed geometry.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway exposes pedestrians to multiple lanes of traffic for a long duration without a refuge.

hazards.name: Discontinuous Sidewalks
hazards.description: The pedestrian path appears to terminate into grass or unpaved areas on the left side of the image.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The intersection geometry allows for high-speed vehicle turns, increasing the risk of collisions with pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and slow down right-turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile, characterized by a wide multi-lane arterial road lacking any visible crossing infrastructure or sidewalks. Pedestrians are exposed to high-speed traffic over long crossing distances without signals or marked paths.

hazards.name: Absence of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are provided at this large intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross unprotected.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area in the middle ground

hazards.name: Extreme Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The roadway width exceeds 60 feet, significantly increasing exposure time to vehicular traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Spanning the width of the multi-lane roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalks
hazards.description: No paved walking surfaces are visible, forcing pedestrians onto the grass or road shoulder.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signalization
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers and push-button activation.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Network Completion
interventions.description: Construct continuous paved sidewalks on both sides of the arterial to separate pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Modify the median to include raised refuge islands, allowing for two-stage crossing.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane arterial intersection designed primarily for high-volume vehicle throughput. Pedestrians face significant exposure due to the extreme crossing distance and a lack of visible refuge islands or high-visibility markings in the foreground.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to multiple lanes of traffic for a long duration without a central refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: Wide travel lanes and a large intersection footprint encourage higher vehicle speeds, increasing the risk of severe injury in a collision.
